rows.note: Consolidation used: 02011R0010 EN 31.08.2023 (017.001), the version the register URL names, obtained as the Publications Office cellar PDF because EUR-Lex itself served an AWS-WAF challenge page to WebFetch/curl. Publications Office SPARQL lists later consolidations (20250120, 20250316, 20260223, 20260714); the latest, 02011R0010 EN 14.07.2026 (021.001), rendered on EUR-Lex in the browser pane, carries the identical Annex II point 1 text and 'Aluminium yes 1'. So the value is current; the register URL merely points at a superseded consolidation snapshot of a regulation that remains in force. 1 mg/kg food x 1000 = 1000 ug/kg; 'specific migration into food' basis and 'plastic food-contact materials and articles' scope match. The 2023 consolidation marks Annex II Table 1 with the M15 (Reg 2020/1245) change marker; the row note's attribution of the Al SML to Reg 2016/1416 (M7 in the amendment list) was not verified against 2016/1416 itself and is not load-bearing for the value.
